# =============================================================================
# Mouse reporting: the encoder (tessera-term) and the routing of mouse and wheel events (tessera-app-core)   (#12, wave 9)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/mouse_spec.txt
#
# Converted from the #12 spec-researcher's tables (2026-11-01) with the milestone lead's decisions applied; every
# expected value comes from the sources below, never from running tessera. Changes against the researcher's tables:
# A34 (a release beyond column 223 is clamped, not dropped) and the new rows U17 and G01-G04, each citing the decision.
#
# SOURCES
#   [CTL] xterm ctlseqs "Mouse Tracking" (X10 compatibility, Normal tracking, Wheel mice, Other buttons, Button-event and
#         Any-event tracking, Extended coordinates 1005/1006/1015/1016): https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html
#   [XB]  xterm button.c (ThomasDickey/xterm-snapshots master, 2026-11-01): MouseLimit, EmitMousePosition, BtnCode,
#         EmitButtonCode, EditorButton (motion dedupe per cell), SendMousePosition; ptyx.h OriginX/OriginY.
#   [AL]  Alacritty alacritty/src/input/mod.rs (mouse_report, normal/sgr_mouse_report, scroll_terminal).
#   [KT]  kitty kitty/mouse.c encode_mouse_event_impl.   [GH] Ghostty src/input/mouse_encode.zig and its unit tests.
#   [IT]  iTerm2 profile prefs (Option bypass).   [WZ] WezTerm bypass_mouse_reporting_modifiers (default SHIFT).
#
# DECISIONS (spec-12-mouse.md "DECISIONS"; "Lead decisions (2026-11-01)" in the wave-9 plan)
#   Q1/Q2  Default encoding: a press, motion or wheel event beyond one-based column or row 223 is not reported (AL/KT/GH;
#          xterm writes a NUL byte); UTF-8 (1005) likewise beyond 2015. A release is never dropped: it is clamped to the limit.
#   Q3     SGR-pixels (1016) prints pixel + 1 (xterm), from the text area's top-left corner (inside the padding); a pointer
#          outside the text area is clamped to its edge before the +1.
#   Q4     Wheel buttons 64-67 are reported as presses only, never released. Back/forward (128/129) press and release.
#   Q5     Routing: a release is sent iff its press was reported, whatever the modifiers at release time.
#   Q6     X10 (DECSET 9): left/middle/right presses only, no modifiers; combines with any encoding.
#   Q7     Motion is reported only when its cell (or pixel, in 1016) differs from the last report of any kind.
#   Q8     Motion with several buttons held reports the lowest held: left, middle, right, back, forward.
#   Q9     Horizontal wheel: the encoder has codes 66/67; the routing does not report horizontal scrolling yet, since the
#          FFI's delta_x_px has no defined sign or unit (lead: defer to 0.2.0).
#   Q10/D2 Shift bypasses reporting (selection); Option is reported as Meta (8); Cmd is never reported.
#   Q11    Wheel: tracking on and no Shift reports on both screens; Shift+wheel scrolls the scrollback on the primary
#          screen and sends the alternate-scroll cursor keys on the alternate screen; X10 + wheel is Ignored.
#   Q12    The click that activates an inactive window is not reported: the frontend swallows it (12-app).
#
# FORMAT
#   Encoder rows (tests/mouse.rs in tessera-term, one encode_mouse call each, through common::check_table):
#     ### <id>          A default, X/N/B/M tracking modes, U UTF-8, S SGR, R urxvt, P SGR-pixels.
#     tracking:         None | X10 | Normal | Button | AnyMotion
#     encoding:         Default | Utf8 | Sgr | Urxvt | SgrPixels
#     event:            press|release|motion  none|left|middle|right|back|forward|wheel-up|wheel-down|wheel-left|wheel-right
#     mods:             - or S, A, C, Cmd joined by + (Shift, Alt/Option, Control, Command)
#     cell: col,row     zero-based cell, as the FFI delivers it
#     px: x,y           (P rows) pixels from the text area's top-left corner, with area: <w>x<h> (MouseReport::with_pixels)
#     expect:           hex bytes, or text with \e for ESC, or none (encode_mouse returns None)
#   Routing rows (src/tests/mouse.rs in tessera-app-core: App::send_input on a session with a fake PTY, 24x80):
#     ### <id>          D sequences, W wheel routing, G routing additions.
#     size: RxC         resize the session first (optional).
#     step: feed <text>                         the child writes <text> (\e for ESC): mode changes, screen switches
#     step: fill <n>                            the child writes n numbered lines (fills the scrollback)
#     step: press|release|motion <button> <col>,<row> [mods] [px x,y] -> C|I   a mouse event and its expected outcome
#     step: wheel <lines> <col>,<row> [mods] -> C|I                             a scroll event of <lines> (delta_lines)
#     step: focus gained|lost -> C|I
#     written: [<n>x ]<text>|none   the bytes queued for the child, in order; several lines concatenate
#     offset: <n>        the scroll offset afterwards (optional)
#     generated:         a row too large to list, checked by the named test
#   cite:/note: are not checked. A case tessera cannot pass yet is a #> block naming the issue that will make it pass.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Encoder tables A (default), X/N/B/M (tracking modes), U (UTF-8), S (SGR), R (urxvt), P (SGR-pixels, cell 8x16, 80x24)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

### A01
tracking: Normal
encoding: Default
event: press left
mods: -
cell: 0,0
expect: 1b 5b 4d 20 21 21
note: ctlseqs example "CSI M ␠ ! !" (button 1 at 1,1) ; xterm

### D01
step: feed \e[?1003h\e[?1006h
step: motion none 5,2 -> C
step: motion none 5,2 -> I
step: motion none 6,2 -> C
step: motion none 5,2 -> C
written: \e[<35;6;3M\e[<35;7;3M\e[<35;6;3M
cite: XB L5612 (row == mouse_row && col == mouse_col => not changed); CTL "only if the pointer has moved to a different character cell"

### D02
step: feed \e[?1003h\e[?1006h
step: motion none 0,0 -> C
written: \e[<35;1;1M
note: the baseline starts empty (xterm -1/-1), so the first motion reports

### D03
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h
step: press left 5,2 -> C
step: motion left 5,2 -> I
written: \e[<0;6;3M
note: the press sets the baseline; a drag in the same cell is suppressed

### D04
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h
step: press left 5,2 -> C
step: motion left 6,2 -> C
step: motion left 6,2 -> I
step: release left 6,2 -> C
written: \e[<0;6;3M\e[<32;7;3M\e[<0;7;3m
note: a release is never deduplicated (XB ButtonRelease does not compare)

### D05
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h
step: press left 5,2 -> C
step: release left 5,2 -> C
step: press left 5,2 -> C
written: \e[<0;6;3M\e[<0;6;3m\e[<0;6;3M
note: presses and releases are never deduplicated

### D06
step: feed \e[?1000h\e[?1006h
step: wheel 3 5,2 -> C
written: 3x \e[<64;6;3M
note: one report per whole line of the accumulator; never deduplicated

### D07
step: feed \e[?1003h\e[?1006h
step: wheel 1 5,2 -> C
step: motion none 5,2 -> I
written: \e[<64;6;3M
note: a wheel report sets the baseline, so motion in the same cell is suppressed

### D08
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h
step: press left 0,0 -> C
step: press right 0,0 -> C
step: motion right 3,0 -> C
written: \e[<0;1;1M\e[<2;1;1M\e[<32;4;1M
note: Q8: the lowest held button (left) is the one a drag reports, whichever button the frontend names

### D09
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h
step: press left 0,0 -> C
step: press right 0,0 -> C
step: release left 0,0 -> C
step: motion right 3,0 -> C
written: \e[<0;1;1M\e[<2;1;1M\e[<0;1;1m\e[<34;4;1M

### D10

step: release left 3,0 -> C
written: \e[<0;1;1M\e[<0;4;1m
note: Q5: the press was reported, so its release is; Normal mode reports no motion. Held state is dropped only when tracking turns off

### D11
step: feed \e[?1002h\e[?1006h

step: feed \e[?1002h
step: release left 0,0 -> I

### D12

### D13

### D20

### D21
generated: flood
note: 100,000 motion events alternating between cells (0,0) and (1,0) give 100,000 reports; 100,000 inside one cell give 1. Checked by the routing test `a_flood_of_motion_reports_only_cell_changes`

### D22
step: feed \e[?1003h\e[?1006h
step: motion none 5,2 -> C
step: focus lost -> C
step: focus gained -> C
step: motion none 5,2 -> I
written: \e[<35;6;3M
note: focus changes (no DECSET 1004 here) send nothing and do not reset the motion baseline

#> D23 -> 12-app: the click that activates an inactive window (press and release) is swallowed by the frontend (Q12);
#>   the core has no notion of window activation, so this row is a Swift routing test in task/12-mouse-app.
#> M8_01 -> #96: with 8-bit controls on (S8C1T), xterm starts mouse reports with 0x9b instead of ESC [ (XB L5540);
#>   every report above stays 7-bit until #96 adds the 8-bit CSI to encode_mouse.

### W09
step: feed \e[?1000h\e[?1006h
step: wheel 1 0,0 C -> C

step: wheel 1 0,0 C -> C
written: \e[<80;1;1M\e[<72;1;1M\e[Mp!!
note: Control adds 16, Option (Meta) 8 (A11, S11); the last is the default encoding, 1b 5b 4d 70 21 21

### W10
step: feed \e[?1000h\e[?1006h
step: wheel 0.4 0,0 -> I
step: wheel 0.4 0,0 -> I
step: wheel 0.4 0,0 -> C
step: wheel -1.5 0,0 -> C
written: \e[<64;1;1M\e[<65;1;1M
note: fractions accumulate (the accumulator take_scroll_lines shares); an event with no whole line writes nothing and is Ignored. The 0.2 left after the third step carries over, so -1.5 takes one line down (0.2 - 1.5 = -1.3)
